{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Final check: compute conversion rate by segment, raw
conversion_rates = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().round(4)
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

# Print the result
print(f"Conversion rates by segment:")
print(conversion_rates)
print(f"\nBest segment: {best_segment} with conversion rate {best_rate}")"}
